title: NorthSide Notes - Insecure Deserialization
description: A nostalgic self-hosted note-taking app built in 2017 uses node-serialize to parse profile cookies. Players discover the vulnerable dependency via breadcrumbs and craft an IIFE deserialization payload to achieve RCE and read their per-user flag.
learningObjectives: Understanding insecure deserialization and its impact
Identifying vulnerable dependencies via exposed package metadata
Researching known CVEs and translating them into working exploits
Crafting IIFE payloads for the node-serialize vulnerability
